name: Documentation Viewer
summary: Documentation viewer CodeComponent combining react-markdown and syntax highlighting. Renders markdown documentation pages with code blocks highlighted via Highlight.default. Sidebar with Accordion-based document tree (Getting Started, API Reference, Guides). Breadcrumb navigation for current path. Copy-to-clipboard Button on code blocks with toast confirmation. useTheme for dark/light code block styling. Three demo markdown documents with TypeScript and JavaScript code examples. Uses Markdown.default, Highlight.default, Accordion, Breadcrumb, Card, Button, ScrollArea, and Icons from the SDK.
shortSummary: Markdown documentation viewer with syntax-highlighted code blocks, sidebar tree, and breadcrumb navigation
